verdicts.reason: A keeps the centred logo and fills the tall canvas evenly. Its three badges are badly broken, though: two sit on one row and SMALL BATCH drops alone to the right on a second row. The dark AWARD WINNING pill nearly disappears, and the body copy is jammed against the badges. B moves the logo to the top-left, unlike the original, and its badges are also staggered unevenly. It packs the body copy tight under a 5-line headline and puts the legal line right under the CTA. That leaves a dead bottom band holding only the stray placeholder image, so the layout feels top-heavy and cramped.
